description: This file contains utility functions for handling paste events, including parsing HTML tables, formatting markdown messages, handling clipboard data, and creating files from clipboard items within the Mattermost web application.

methods.name: parseHtmlTable
methods.description: Parses an HTML string to extract a table element.

methods.name: getHtmlTable
methods.description: Retrieves an HTML table element from clipboard data if present.

methods.name: hasHtmlLink
methods.description: Checks if clipboard data contains an HTML link.

methods.name: isGitHubCodeBlock
methods.description: Determines if a class name indicates a GitHub code block.

methods.name: isTextUrl
methods.description: Checks if clipboard text starts with http:// or https://.

methods.name: hasPlainText
methods.description: Checks if clipboard data contains non-empty plain text.

methods.name: formatMarkdownMessage
methods.description: Converts HTML clipboard data into a Markdown message, optionally inserting into existing message at caret position.

methods.name: formatGithubCodePaste
methods.description: Formats clipboard data containing code into a markdown code block, inserting into message.

methods.name: formatMarkdownLinkMessage
methods.description: Creates a markdown link from selected text and clipboard URL.

methods.name: isKnownTargetForPaste
methods.description: Checks if the paste event target is a recognized textbox based on location and mode.

methods.name: pasteHandler
methods.description: Handles paste events, applying markdown formatting or code blocks as appropriate.

methods.name: createFileFromClipboardDataItem
methods.description: Creates a File object from a DataTransferItem, generating a filename if necessary.
